title: A Leak in One Apartment and a Roof Over All of Them
description: One wet ceiling in a Houston apartment building is often a roof detail above that unit, and sometimes a problem that repeats down the building.
html:
The tenant calls about a stain. The roof over that unit is also the roof over the unit beside it. Painting the ceiling and leaving the roof is how the same call comes back next rain.

Start above the stain

On a shingle apartment roof the usual entries are a pipe boot, a valley full of leaves, or flashing where two buildings meet. Those are the same three spots as a house, and a repair there can be the whole job. On a low-slope building the water may have traveled under the membrane from a seam or a curb that is not above the wet unit at all. The ceiling tells you where it dropped. It does not always tell you where it entered.

One unit is not a scope

We look at the slope over the complaint and at the same details on the rest of the building. A cracked boot on one stack is often a cracked boot on the next stack. Replacing every roof because one ceiling stained is the other mistake. The building page is commercial roofing, and the maintenance side is repair and preventative maintenance.
